/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Notebook state related styling
|
| The notebook and cells each have states, here are the possibilities:
|
| - Notebook
|   - Command
|   - Edit
| - Cell
|   - None
|   - Active (only one can be active)
|   - Selected (the cells actions are applied to)
|   - Multiselected (when multiple selected, the cursor)
|   - No outputs
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*
The following CSS variables define the main, public API for styling JupyterLab.
These variables should be used by all plugins wherever possible. In other
words, plugins should not define custom colors, sizes, etc unless absolutely
necessary. This enables users to change the visual theme of JupyterLab
by changing these variables.

Many variables appear in an ordered sequence (0,1,2,3). These sequences
are designed to work well together, so for example, `--jp-border-color1` should
be used with `--jp-layout-color1`. The numbers have the following meanings:

* 0: super-primary, reserved for special emphasis
* 1: primary, most important under normal situations
* 2: secondary, next most important under normal situations
* 3: tertiary, next most important under normal situations

Throughout JupyterLab, we are mostly following principles from Google's
Material Design when selecting colors. We are not, however, following
all of MD as it is not optimized for dense, information rich UIs.
*/

<!-- End of mathjax configuration --><script type="module">
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
    const diagrams = document.querySelectorAll(".jp-Mermaid > pre.mermaid");
    // do not load mermaidjs if not needed
    if (!diagrams.length) {
      return;
    }
    const mermaid = (await import("https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mermaid/10.7.0/mermaid.esm.min.mjs")).default;
    const parser = new DOMParser();

    mermaid.initialize({
      maxTextSize: 100000,
      maxEdges: 100000,
      startOnLoad: false,
      fontFamily: window
        .getComputedStyle(document.body)
        .getPropertyValue("--jp-ui-font-family"),
      theme: document.querySelector("body[data-jp-theme-light='true']")
        ? "default"
        : "dark",
    });

    let _nextMermaidId = 0;

    function makeMermaidImage(svg) {
      const img = document.createElement("img");
      const doc = parser.parseFromString(svg, "image/svg+xml");
      const svgEl = doc.querySelector("svg");
      const { maxWidth } = svgEl?.style || {};
      const firstTitle = doc.querySelector("title");
      const firstDesc = doc.querySelector("desc");

      img.setAttribute("src", `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`);
      if (maxWidth) {
        img.width = parseInt(maxWidth);
      }
      if (firstTitle) {
        img.setAttribute("alt", firstTitle.textContent);
      }
      if (firstDesc) {
        const caption = document.createElement("figcaption");
        caption.className = "sr-only";
        caption.textContent = firstDesc.textContent;
        return [img, caption];
      }
      return [img];
    }

    async function makeMermaidError(text) {
      let errorMessage = "";
      try {
        await mermaid.parse(text);
      } catch (err) {
        errorMessage = `${err}`;
      }

      const result = document.createElement("details");
      result.className = 'jp-RenderedMermaid-Details';
      const summary = document.createElement("summary");
      summary.className = 'jp-RenderedMermaid-Summary';
      const pre = document.createElement("pre");
      const code = document.createElement("code");
      code.innerText = text;
      pre.appendChild(code);
      summary.appendChild(pre);
      result.appendChild(summary);

      const warning = document.createElement("pre");
      warning.innerText = errorMessage;
      result.appendChild(warning);
      return [result];
    }

    async function renderOneMarmaid(src) {
      const id = `jp-mermaid-${_nextMermaidId++}`;
      const parent = src.parentNode;
      let raw = src.textContent.trim();
      const el = document.createElement("div");
      el.style.visibility = "hidden";
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      let results = null;
      let output = null;
      try {
        let { svg } = await mermaid.render(id, raw, el);
        svg = cleanMermaidSvg(svg);
        results = makeMermaidImage(svg);
        output = document.createElement("figure");
        results.map(output.appendChild, output);
      } catch (err) {
        parent.classList.add("jp-mod-warning");
        results = await makeMermaidError(raw);
        output = results[0];
      } finally {
        el.remove();
      }
      parent.classList.add("jp-RenderedMermaid");
      parent.appendChild(output);
    }


    /**
     * Post-process to ensure mermaid diagrams contain only valid SVG and XHTML.
     */
    function cleanMermaidSvg(svg) {
      return svg.replace(RE_VOID_ELEMENT, replaceVoidElement);
    }


    /**
     * A regular expression for all void elements, which may include attributes and
     * a slash.
     *
     * @see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Void_element
     *
     * Of these, only `<br>` is generated by Mermaid in place of `\n`,
     * but _any_ "malformed" tag will break the SVG rendering entirely.
     */
    const RE_VOID_ELEMENT =
      /<\s*(area|base|br|col|embed|hr|img|input|link|meta|param|source|track|wbr)\s*([^>]*?)\s*>/gi;

    /**
     * Ensure a void element is closed with a slash, preserving any attributes.
     */
    function replaceVoidElement(match, tag, rest) {
      rest = rest.trim();
      if (!rest.endsWith('/')) {
        rest = `${rest} /`;
      }
      return `<${tag} ${rest}>`;
    }

    void Promise.all([...diagrams].map(renderOneMarmaid));
  });
</script>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="n">AUDIO_EXT</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">".wav"</span>
<span class="n">VIDEO_EXT</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">".mp4"</span>

<span class="c1"># --- AUDIO CHUNKER ---</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">chunk_audio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sf</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">chunk_length</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">audio_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">chunk_length</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">chunk</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">chunk_length</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">chunk_length</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">0.8</span><span class="p">:</span>  <span class="c1"># only keep fairly full chunks</span>
            <span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span>

<span class="c1"># --- VIDEO CHUNKER ---</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">chunk_video</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">clip</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">VideoFileClip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">video_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">clip</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">duration</span>
    <span class="n">t</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span>
    <span class="k">while</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">duration</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">subclip</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">clip</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subclip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">video_chunks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subclip</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">t</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">video_chunks</span>

<span class="c1"># --- WRAPPER FOR SYNCHRONIZED AUDIO/VIDEO CHUNKS ---</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">chunk_av_for_affect</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">audio_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">chunk_audio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">video_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">chunk_video</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">min_len</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_chunks</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">[:</span><span class="n">min_len</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">video_chunks</span><span class="p">[:</span><span class="n">min_len</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">sr</span>
    
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">process_audio_affect_from_videos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">content_type</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"music"</span><span class="p">):</span> <span class="c1"># OR CONTENT TYPE, "env"!!!!!!!!!!</span>
    <span class="n">results</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">file</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">listdir</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">file</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">endswith</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">".mp4"</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">basename</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">splitext</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="p">)[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">mp4_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">file</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">wav_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">basename</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">.wav"</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"🔍 Processing </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="c1"># Extract WAV from MP4</span>
            <span class="n">extract_audio_from_mp4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">mp4_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">wav_path</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="c1"># Chunk audio</span>
            <span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">chunk_audio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">wav_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="c1"># Extract affect vectors per chunk</span>
            <span class="n">vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
                <span class="n">extract_audio_affect_vector</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">chunk</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">audio_chunks</span>
            <span class="p">]</span>

            <span class="n">results</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                <span class="s2">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">basename</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"n_chunks"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s2">"vectors"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">vectors</span>
            <span class="p">}</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">results</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">continue_audio_affect_from_videos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">content_type</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"music"</span><span class="p">):</span> <span class="c1"># OR CONTENT "env"!!!!!!!!!!!!</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">file</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">listdir</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="c1"># if file.lower().endswith(".mp4"):</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">file</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_affect_vectors</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">keys</span><span class="p">()):</span>
                <span class="n">basename</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">splitext</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="p">)[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="n">wav_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">file</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="c1"># wav_path = os.path.join(folder_path, f"{basename}.wav")</span>

                <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"🔍 Processing </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="c1"># Extract WAV from MP4</span>
                <span class="c1"># extract_audio_from_mp4(mp4_path, wav_path)</span>

                <span class="c1"># Chunk audio</span>
                <span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">chunk_audio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">wav_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="c1"># Extract affect vectors per chunk</span>
                <span class="n">vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
                    <span class="n">extract_audio_affect_vector</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">chunk</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">audio_chunks</span>
                <span class="p">]</span>

                <span class="n">audio_affect_vectors</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                    <span class="s2">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">basename</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"n_chunks"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_chunks</span><span class="p">),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"vectors"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">vectors</span>
                <span class="p">}</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">chunk_video_frames</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">VideoCapture</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FPS</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Could not determine FPS for video: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">fps</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">current_chunk</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="n">success</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">while</span> <span class="n">success</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">frame_rgb</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cvtColor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">COLOR_BGR2RGB</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">current_chunk</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame_rgb</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_chunk</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">chunks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_chunk</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">current_chunk</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

        <span class="n">success</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">()</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_chunk</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">0.5</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">chunks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_chunk</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">release</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">chunks</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">get_clip_vector</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame_rgb</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">processor</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">processor</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">device</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"mps"</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="c1"># Convert frame to PIL image</span>
    <span class="n">image</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fromarray</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame_rgb</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Preprocess image using the processor</span>
    <span class="n">inputs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">processor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">images</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">image</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">return_tensors</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"pt"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">device</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">torch</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">no_grad</span><span class="p">():</span>
        <span class="n">outputs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_image_features</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">**</span><span class="n">inputs</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Return as a NumPy array</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">outputs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">squeeze</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cpu</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">numpy</span><span class="p">()</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">extract_video_affect_vector</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_frames</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">get_clip_vector</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">chunk_frames</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vectors</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">process_video_affect_from_videos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">results</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">file</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">listdir</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">file</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">endswith</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">".mp4"</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">video_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">folder_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">file</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"🎥 Processing </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">video_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">chunk_video_frames</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="n">vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">extract_video_affect_vector</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">chunk</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">video_chunks</span><span class="p">]</span>

                <span class="n">results</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                    <span class="s2">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">file</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"n_chunks"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_chunks</span><span class="p">),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"vectors"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">vectors</span>
                <span class="p">}</span>
            <span class="k">except</span> <span class="ne">Exception</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">e</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"❌ Failed to process </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">file</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">continue</span>

            <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'nonotak_narcisse_affect_vectors_2s.pkl'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'wb'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">fp</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">pickle</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dump</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">results</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fp</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">results</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.metrics.pairwise</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">cosine_similarity</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>

<span class="c1"># Function to compute coherence metrics</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">compare_audio_video_affect</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_vectors</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">video_vectors</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_vectors</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="s2">"Chunk counts must match"</span>
    <span class="n">similarities</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">cosine_similarity</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">v</span><span class="p">])[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">a</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">zip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_vectors</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">video_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">similarities</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">similarities</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s2">"similarities"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">similarities</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"redundancy_score"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">similarities</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s2">"counterpoint_score"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">similarities</span><span class="p">)),</span>
        <span class="s2">"variability"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">similarities</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s2">"delta_similarity"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">similarities</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
</pre></div>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">process_audio_video_coherence_2s</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_dict</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">video_dict</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">allow_mismatch</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">):</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="n">What</span> <span class="ow">is</span> min_samples<span class="o">?</span>
<span class="err">🎯</span> <span class="n">Definition</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="n">The</span> <span class="n">minimum</span> <span class="n">number</span> <span class="n">of</span> <span class="n">points</span> <span class="n">required</span> <span class="n">to</span> <span class="n">form</span> <span class="n">a</span> <span class="n">dense</span> <span class="n">region</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">a</span> <span class="n">core</span> <span class="n">point</span> <span class="n">of</span> <span class="n">a</span> <span class="n">cluster</span><span class="o">.</span>

<span class="err">📌</span> <span class="n">If</span> <span class="n">a</span> <span class="n">point</span> <span class="n">has</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="err">≥</span> <span class="n">min_samples</span> <span class="n">neighbors</span> <span class="n">within</span> <span class="n">eps</span> <span class="err">→</span> <span class="n">it</span><span class="s1">'s a core of a cluster.</span>

<span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">min_samples</span> <span class="err">→</span> <span class="n">it</span><span class="s1">'s a border point or noise (label = -1).</span>

<span class="err">🔍</span> <span class="n">Typical</span> <span class="n">values</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="n">Often</span> <span class="nb">set</span> <span class="n">to</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="err">–</span><span class="mi">5</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">small</span> <span class="n">datasets</span><span class="o">.</span>

<span class="n">Larger</span> <span class="n">values</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">like</span> <span class="mi">10</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">denser</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">high</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">dimensional</span> <span class="n">data</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">image</span> <span class="n">embeddings</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span>
</pre></div>
</div>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">compute_recursive_drift</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">labels</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">motif_instances</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="n">event_types</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="c1"># Dynamically computed time threshold</span>
    <span class="n">avg_segment_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([(</span><span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">])</span>
    <span class="c1"># time_threshold = max(2.0, avg_segment_duration * 1.5)  # or some multiple of avg segment size</span>
    <span class="n">time_threshold</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">2.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">avg_segment_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># using multiples of avg_segment_duration for clearer distinction between loop and return</span>
    
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">features</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">label</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">labels</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">label</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span>   <span class="c1"># the last one</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">label</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">motif_instances</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">motif_instances</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="n">motif_instances</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">features</span><span class="p">))</span>

    <span class="n">drift_scores</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">label</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">instances</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">motif_instances</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">():</span>
        <span class="n">instances</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">instances</span><span class="p">)):</span>
            <span class="n">prev</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">instances</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">curr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">instances</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">euclidean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">curr</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">prev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">])</span>   <span class="c1"># distance between features</span>
            <span class="n">time_drift</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">curr</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">prev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span>   <span class="c1"># window_duration = 1.0 [seconds]  hop_duration = 0.5 [seconds]</span>
            <span class="n">drift</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span>
            <span class="n">drift_scores</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">drift</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="c1"># Event typing based on thresholds (adjustable)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.3</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">time_threshold</span><span class="p">:</span>  <span class="c1"># small feature + small time drift → loop</span>
                <span class="n">event_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'loop'</span>
            <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.3</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">time_threshold</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">event_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'return'</span>  <span class="c1"># or 'resonance', 'memory motif'</span>
            <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.7</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">time_threshold</span><span class="p">:</span>  <span class="c1"># large time drift + medium feature drift → recursive echo</span>
                <span class="n">event_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'recursive echo'</span>
            <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="mf">0.7</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">time_threshold</span><span class="p">:</span>   <span class="c1"># small time, large feature drift → mutation (e.g., ironic chorus?)</span>
                <span class="n">event_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'mutation'</span>
            <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>                            <span class="c1"># large time + large feature drift → ghost return or palimpsest</span>
                <span class="n">event_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'ghost return'</span>  <span class="c1"># significant transformation + long delay</span>

            <span class="n">event_types</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                <span class="s1">'label'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">label</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">prev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">curr</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s1">'feature_drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_drift</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s1">'drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">drift</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s1">'time_drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">time_drift</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s1">'duration_prev'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">prev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">prev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s1">'duration_curr'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">curr</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">curr</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">event_type</span>
            <span class="p">})</span>

    <span class="n">recursive_score</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">drift_scores</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">drift_scores</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">recursive_score</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">event_types</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_audio_file</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file_path</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">y</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">window_size</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">window_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>    <span class="c1"># window_duration = 1.0 seconds [but that can be changed]</span>
    <span class="n">hop_size</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>      <span class="c1"># hop_duration = 0.5 seconds</span>

    <span class="c1"># Extract features</span>
    <span class="n">feature_vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">start</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">window_size</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_size</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">window</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">y</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">start</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">window_size</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">mfcc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">feature</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mfcc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">window</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">chroma</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">feature</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">chroma_stft</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">window</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">rms</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">feature</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">rms</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">window</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">feature_vector</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">concatenate</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">mfcc</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chroma</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">rms</span><span class="p">]])</span>
        <span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_vector</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">feature_vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Compute FVI</span>
    <span class="n">fv_array</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fvi</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fv_array</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)),</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fv_array</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="mf">1e-6</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fvi_normalized</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">fvi</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fvi</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">weighted_features</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">fv_array</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">fvi_normalized</span>

    <span class="c1"># Change scores and ruptures</span>
    <span class="n">change_scores</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">euclidean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)]</span>
    <span class="n">threshold</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">change_scores</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">change_scores</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">0.5</span>
    <span class="n">ruptures</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">score</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">change_scores</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">score</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="n">threshold</span><span class="p">]</span>

    <span class="c1"># Segment features</span>
    <span class="n">segments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">start_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">rupture_idx</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">ruptures</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]:</span>
        <span class="n">segment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">start_idx</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">rupture_idx</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">avg_feature</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">segments</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">start_idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rupture_idx</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">avg_feature</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">start_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">rupture_idx</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span>

    <span class="n">segment_features</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">seg</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">seg</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">similarity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cosine_similarity</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment_features</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">clustering</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">DBSCAN</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">eps</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">eps</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">min_samples</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">min_samples</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">metric</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'cosine'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment_features</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">labels</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">clustering</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">labels_</span>

    <span class="n">avg_segment_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([(</span><span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">])</span>
    <span class="n">rupture_threshold</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">1.5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">avg_segment_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">0.75</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span>
        <span class="n">label</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">labels</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">rupture_threshold</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">idx</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">idx</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">ruptures</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">seg_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'rupture'</span>
        <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">label</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">seg_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'unique'</span>
        <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">seg_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'motif'</span>
        <span class="n">segment_annotations</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
            <span class="s1">'start'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">start</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s1">'end'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">seg_type</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s1">'label'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">label</span>
        <span class="p">})</span>

    <span class="c1"># Calculate scores</span>
    <span class="n">n_segments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment_annotations</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">n_motifs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">s</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'motif'</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">n_uniques</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">s</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'unique'</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">n_ruptures</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">s</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'rupture'</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">score_linear</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n_ruptures</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">n_uniques</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span>
    <span class="n">score_cyclical</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">n_motifs</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span>
    <span class="n">score_recursive</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">l</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'label'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">l</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">l</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'label'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">))</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span>  <span class="c1"># number of segments that are not unique [i.e., not part of a cluster]</span>
    <span class="n">score_hybrid</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_linear</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">score_cyclical</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Compute drift-based recursion and event typing</span>
    <span class="n">recursive_drift_score</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">event_types</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">compute_recursive_drift</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">labels</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s1">'file'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">basename</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file_path</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'segments'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'segment_annotations'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'motifs'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_motifs</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'uniques'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_uniques</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'ruptures'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_ruptures</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_linear'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_linear</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_cyclical'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_cyclical</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_recursive'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_recursive</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_recursive_drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">recursive_drift_score</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_hybrid'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_hybrid</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'recursive_events'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">event_types</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
</pre></div>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="n">audio_dir</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"Nonotak/"</span>

<span class="n">audio_temporal_flow_scores</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">fname</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">listdir</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_dir</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="c1"># if fname.lower().endswith(('.wav', '.mp3', '.flac', '.ogg', '.m4a')):</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">fname</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">endswith</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'.mp4'</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_dir</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fname</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Analyzing </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">fname</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">analyze_audio_file</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">audio_temporal_flow_scores</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'nonotak_audio_linear_cyclical_recursive_scores_2.pkl'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'wb'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">fi</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">pickle</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dump</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_temporal_flow_scores</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fi</span><span class="p">)</span>
