<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.metrics.pairwise</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">cosine_distances</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="c1"># from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">os</span>

<span class="n">frame_rate</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">2</span>

<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">cv2</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">extract_frames</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_rate</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Extract frames from the video at `frame_rate` frames per second.</span>
<span class="sd">    Returns list of PIL Images for compatibility with CLIPProcessor.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">PIL</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Image</span>
    
    <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">VideoCapture</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FPS</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">interval</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">frame_rate</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">frame_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    
    <span class="k">while</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">break</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">frame_idx</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="n">interval</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="c1"># Convert BGR (OpenCV) to RGB (PIL)</span>
            <span class="n">frame_rgb</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cvtColor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">COLOR_BGR2RGB</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">pil_img</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Image</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fromarray</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame_rgb</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">frames</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pil_img</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">frame_idx</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
    
    <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">release</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">frames</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">detect_video_recursion</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">frame_embeddings</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">time_threshold</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">feature_drift_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.3</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">merge_gap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">from_merge_gap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">n_segments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame_embeddings</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">dists</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cosine_distances</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame_embeddings</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">all_pairs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n_segments</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">dists</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">time_drift</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span>

            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">feature_drift_threshold</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">event_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'loop'</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">time_threshold</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="s1">'return'</span>
                <span class="n">all_pairs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                    <span class="s1">'from_idx'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'to_idx'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'feature_drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">feature_drift</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'time_drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">time_drift</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'duration_prev'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'duration_curr'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">event_type</span>
                <span class="p">})</span>

    <span class="n">merged_events</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">all_pairs</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">all_pairs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from_idx'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to_idx'</span><span class="p">]))</span>
        <span class="n">current_event</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dict</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">all_pairs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>

        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ev</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">all_pairs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:]:</span>
            <span class="n">same_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">from_gap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">to_gap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">]</span>

            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">same_type</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">from_gap</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">from_merge_gap</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">to_gap</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">merge_gap</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to_idx'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to_idx'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to_idx'</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from_idx'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from_idx'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from_idx'</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'feature_drift'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'feature_drift'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'feature_drift'</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'drift'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'drift'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'drift'</span><span class="p">])</span>
            <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">total_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="n">avg_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'duration_prev'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'duration_curr'</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mi">2</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'total_duration'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">total_duration</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'avg_duration'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">avg_duration</span>
                <span class="n">merged_events</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="n">current_event</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dict</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">total_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'to'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'from'</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">avg_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'duration_prev'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'duration_curr'</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mi">2</span>
        <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'total_duration'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">total_duration</span>
        <span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'avg_duration'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">avg_duration</span>
        <span class="n">merged_events</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_event</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">merged_events</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">all_pairs</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">get_frame_embeddings</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">model</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">processor</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">device</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"mps"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">batch_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Given a list of PIL images, return their normalized embeddings from CLIP.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">eval</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">all_embeddings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">torch</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">no_grad</span><span class="p">():</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">img</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">inputs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">processor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">images</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">img</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">return_tensors</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"pt"</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">device</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">outputs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_image_features</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">**</span><span class="n">inputs</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">embeddings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">outputs</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">outputs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">norm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dim</span><span class="o">=-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">keepdim</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># normalize</span>
            <span class="n">all_embeddings</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">embeddings</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cpu</span><span class="p">())</span>
    
    <span class="n">all_embeddings</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">torch</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">all_embeddings</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dim</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># shape (N_frames, embedding_dim)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">all_embeddings</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">typing</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">List</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Dict</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_video_file</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">window_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">eps</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">min_samples</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">):</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Extract features</span>
    <span class="n">feature_vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">get_frame_embeddings</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">extract_frames</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_rate</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">processor</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">processor</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">device</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">device</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">feature_vectors</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">frame_rate</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>  <span class="c1"># Assuming frame_rate=1 fps here; adjust as needed</span>
    <span class="n">hop_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">frame_rate</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Compute FVI (optional, as per your original code)</span>
    <span class="n">fv_array</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fvi</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fv_array</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)),</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fv_array</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="mf">1e-6</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fvi_normalized</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">fvi</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fvi</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">weighted_features</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">fv_array</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">fvi_normalized</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Change scores and ruptures</span>
    <span class="n">change_scores</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">linalg</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">norm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)]</span>
    <span class="n">threshold</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">change_scores</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">change_scores</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">0.5</span>
    <span class="n">ruptures</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">score</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">change_scores</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">score</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="n">threshold</span><span class="p">]</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Segment features</span>
    <span class="n">segments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">start_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">rupture_idx</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">ruptures</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]:</span>
        <span class="n">segment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">weighted_features</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">start_idx</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">rupture_idx</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">avg_feature</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">segments</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">start_idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">rupture_idx</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">avg_feature</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">start_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">rupture_idx</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span>
    
    <span class="n">segment_features</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">seg</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">seg</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">]</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Clustering segments</span>
    <span class="n">clustering</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">DBSCAN</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">eps</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">eps</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">min_samples</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">min_samples</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">metric</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'cosine'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment_features</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">labels</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">clustering</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">labels_</span>
    
    <span class="n">avg_segment_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([(</span><span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">])</span>
    <span class="n">rupture_threshold</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">1.5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">avg_segment_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">0.75</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segments</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">start</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span>
        <span class="n">label</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">labels</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">rupture_threshold</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">idx</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">idx</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">ruptures</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">seg_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'rupture'</span>
        <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">label</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">seg_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'unique'</span>
        <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">seg_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'motif'</span>
        <span class="n">segment_annotations</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
            <span class="s1">'start'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">start</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s1">'end'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">end</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">seg_type</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s1">'label'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">label</span>
        <span class="p">})</span>

    <span class="c1"># Scores calculation</span>
    <span class="n">n_segments</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">segment_annotations</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">n_motifs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">s</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'motif'</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">n_uniques</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">s</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'unique'</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">n_ruptures</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">s</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'rupture'</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">score_linear</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n_ruptures</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">n_uniques</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span>
    <span class="n">score_cyclical</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">n_motifs</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span>
    <span class="n">score_recursive</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">l</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'label'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">l</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">l</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'label'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">))</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span>
    <span class="n">score_hybrid</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_linear</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">score_cyclical</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Calculate time threshold for recursion detection</span>
    <span class="n">time_threshold</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">2.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">avg_segment_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Use new detect_video_recursion to get merged recursive events and all pairs</span>
    <span class="n">recursive_events</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">all_pairs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">detect_video_recursion</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">frame_embeddings</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">feature_vectors</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">hop_duration</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">time_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">time_threshold</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">feature_drift_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.3</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">merge_gap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">from_merge_gap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Compute recursive_drift_score as average drift of merged events</span>
    <span class="n">recursive_drift_score</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">ev</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'drift'</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ev</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">recursive_events</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">recursive_events</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s1">'file'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">basename</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">file_path</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'segments'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_segments</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'segment_annotations'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">segment_annotations</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'motifs'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_motifs</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'uniques'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_uniques</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'ruptures'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">n_ruptures</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_linear'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_linear</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_cyclical'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_cyclical</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_recursive'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_recursive</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_recursive_drift'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">recursive_drift_score</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'score_hybrid'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">score_hybrid</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'recursive_events'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">recursive_events</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'all_recursive_pairs'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">all_pairs</span>  <span class="c1"># Optional, for debugging if needed</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="n">video_dir</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"Nonotak/"</span>

<span class="n">video_temporal_flows</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">fname</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">listdir</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_dir</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="c1"># if fname.lower().endswith(('.wav', '.mp3', '.flac', '.ogg', '.m4a')):</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">fname</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">endswith</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'.mp4'</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_dir</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fname</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Analyzing </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">fname</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">analyze_video_file</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">video_temporal_flows</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'nonotak_video_linear_cyclical_recursive_scores_2.pkl'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'wb'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">fo</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">pickle</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dump</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_temporal_flows</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fo</span><span class="p">)</span>

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Notebook state related styling
|
| The notebook and cells each have states, here are the possibilities:
|
| - Notebook
|   - Command
|   - Edit
| - Cell
|   - None
|   - Active (only one can be active)
|   - Selected (the cells actions are applied to)
|   - Multiselected (when multiple selected, the cursor)
|   - No outputs
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*
The following CSS variables define the main, public API for styling JupyterLab.
These variables should be used by all plugins wherever possible. In other
words, plugins should not define custom colors, sizes, etc unless absolutely
necessary. This enables users to change the visual theme of JupyterLab
by changing these variables.

Many variables appear in an ordered sequence (0,1,2,3). These sequences
are designed to work well together, so for example, `--jp-border-color1` should
be used with `--jp-layout-color1`. The numbers have the following meanings:

* 0: super-primary, reserved for special emphasis
* 1: primary, most important under normal situations
* 2: secondary, next most important under normal situations
* 3: tertiary, next most important under normal situations

Throughout JupyterLab, we are mostly following principles from Google's
Material Design when selecting colors. We are not, however, following
all of MD as it is not optimized for dense, information rich UIs.
*/

<!-- End of mathjax configuration --><script type="module">
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
    const diagrams = document.querySelectorAll(".jp-Mermaid > pre.mermaid");
    // do not load mermaidjs if not needed
    if (!diagrams.length) {
      return;
    }
    const mermaid = (await import("https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mermaid/10.7.0/mermaid.esm.min.mjs")).default;
    const parser = new DOMParser();

    mermaid.initialize({
      maxTextSize: 100000,
      maxEdges: 100000,
      startOnLoad: false,
      fontFamily: window
        .getComputedStyle(document.body)
        .getPropertyValue("--jp-ui-font-family"),
      theme: document.querySelector("body[data-jp-theme-light='true']")
        ? "default"
        : "dark",
    });

    let _nextMermaidId = 0;

    function makeMermaidImage(svg) {
      const img = document.createElement("img");
      const doc = parser.parseFromString(svg, "image/svg+xml");
      const svgEl = doc.querySelector("svg");
      const { maxWidth } = svgEl?.style || {};
      const firstTitle = doc.querySelector("title");
      const firstDesc = doc.querySelector("desc");

      img.setAttribute("src", `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`);
      if (maxWidth) {
        img.width = parseInt(maxWidth);
      }
      if (firstTitle) {
        img.setAttribute("alt", firstTitle.textContent);
      }
      if (firstDesc) {
        const caption = document.createElement("figcaption");
        caption.className = "sr-only";
        caption.textContent = firstDesc.textContent;
        return [img, caption];
      }
      return [img];
    }

    async function makeMermaidError(text) {
      let errorMessage = "";
      try {
        await mermaid.parse(text);
      } catch (err) {
        errorMessage = `${err}`;
      }

      const result = document.createElement("details");
      result.className = 'jp-RenderedMermaid-Details';
      const summary = document.createElement("summary");
      summary.className = 'jp-RenderedMermaid-Summary';
      const pre = document.createElement("pre");
      const code = document.createElement("code");
      code.innerText = text;
      pre.appendChild(code);
      summary.appendChild(pre);
      result.appendChild(summary);

      const warning = document.createElement("pre");
      warning.innerText = errorMessage;
      result.appendChild(warning);
      return [result];
    }

    async function renderOneMarmaid(src) {
      const id = `jp-mermaid-${_nextMermaidId++}`;
      const parent = src.parentNode;
      let raw = src.textContent.trim();
      const el = document.createElement("div");
      el.style.visibility = "hidden";
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      let results = null;
      let output = null;
      try {
        let { svg } = await mermaid.render(id, raw, el);
        svg = cleanMermaidSvg(svg);
        results = makeMermaidImage(svg);
        output = document.createElement("figure");
        results.map(output.appendChild, output);
      } catch (err) {
        parent.classList.add("jp-mod-warning");
        results = await makeMermaidError(raw);
        output = results[0];
      } finally {
        el.remove();
      }
      parent.classList.add("jp-RenderedMermaid");
      parent.appendChild(output);
    }


    /**
     * Post-process to ensure mermaid diagrams contain only valid SVG and XHTML.
     */
    function cleanMermaidSvg(svg) {
      return svg.replace(RE_VOID_ELEMENT, replaceVoidElement);
    }


    /**
     * A regular expression for all void elements, which may include attributes and
     * a slash.
     *
     * @see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Void_element
     *
     * Of these, only `<br>` is generated by Mermaid in place of `\n`,
     * but _any_ "malformed" tag will break the SVG rendering entirely.
     */
    const RE_VOID_ELEMENT =
      /<\s*(area|base|br|col|embed|hr|img|input|link|meta|param|source|track|wbr)\s*([^>]*?)\s*>/gi;

    /**
     * Ensure a void element is closed with a slash, preserving any attributes.
     */
    function replaceVoidElement(match, tag, rest) {
      rest = rest.trim();
      if (!rest.endsWith('/')) {
        rest = `${rest} /`;
      }
      return `<${tag} ${rest}>`;
    }

    void Promise.all([...diagrams].map(renderOneMarmaid));
  });
</script>

<div class="cm-editor cm-s-jupyter">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_video_features_mapped</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.5</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Extract video features aligned with audio feature mappings and return normalized feature vector.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">VideoCapture</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FPS</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">fps</span>
    <span class="n">chunk_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">fps</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">frame_density</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">motion_intensity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">scene_changes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">luminance_variance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">visual_silence_ratio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
    <span class="n">total_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">silent_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

    <span class="k">while</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">isOpened</span><span class="p">():</span>
        <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">break</span>

        <span class="c1"># Convert frame to grayscale</span>
        <span class="n">gray_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cvtColor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">COLOR_BGR2GRAY</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Frame density: Count frames over time</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_chunks</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="n">chunk_frames</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">frame_density</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">frame_density</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

        <span class="c1"># Motion intensity: Difference between frames</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">diff</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">absdiff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">prev_frame</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">motion_intensity</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">))</span>
        
        <span class="c1"># Transition sharpness: Histogram difference (scene changes)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">hist_diff</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">compareHist</span><span class="p">(</span>
                <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">calcHist</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">256</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">256</span><span class="p">]),</span>
                <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">calcHist</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">prev_frame</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">256</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">256</span><span class="p">]),</span>
                <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">HISTCMP_CORREL</span>
            <span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">hist_diff</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">hist_diff</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.5</span><span class="p">:</span>  <span class="c1"># Scene change threshold</span>
                <span class="n">scene_changes</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

        <span class="c1"># Edge dynamics: Mean of Canny edge detector</span>
        <span class="n">edges</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Canny</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edges</span><span class="p">))</span>
        
        <span class="c1"># Luminance variance: Variance in brightness</span>
        <span class="n">luminance_variance</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">))</span>

        <span class="c1"># Visual silence: Detect "static" or low-variance chunks</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_chunks</span> <span class="o">%</span> <span class="n">chunk_frames</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">static_threshold</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.1</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">luminance_variance</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">static_threshold</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">silent_chunks</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

        <span class="c1"># Update previous frame and chunk count</span>
        <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">gray_frame</span>
        <span class="n">total_chunks</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

    <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">release</span><span class="p">()</span>

    <span class="c1"># Aggregate features</span>
    <span class="n">frame_density</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame_density</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">motion_intensity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">motion_intensity</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">transition_sharpness</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">luminance_variance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">luminance_variance</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">visual_silence_ratio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">silent_chunks</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">total_chunks</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_chunks</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">scene_change_frequency</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">scene_changes</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">duration</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

    <span class="c1"># Return feature vector</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s1">'frame_density'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">frame_density</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'motion_intensity'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">motion_intensity</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'transition_sharpness'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'edge_dynamics'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'scene_change_frequency'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">scene_change_frequency</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'luminance_variance'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">luminance_variance</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'visual_silence_ratio'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">visual_silence_ratio</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1">#import numpy as np</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">librosa</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">calculate_pacing_variance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2048</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">):</span>

    <span class="n">spectral_flux</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sqrt</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rms</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">**</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># Optional addition: adding spectral flux   </span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rms</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">spectral_flux</span>  <span class="c1"># Combine RMS std and spectral flux for rhythm</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">calculate_fricative_density</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2048</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fricative_range</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">4000</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">8000</span><span class="p">)):</span>
    <span class="n">stft</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">stft</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n_fft</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">freqs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fft_frequencies</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n_fft</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fricative_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">where</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">freqs</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">fricative_range</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">freqs</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">fricative_range</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]))[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
    
    <span class="n">fricative_energy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">stft</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">fricative_idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">:]</span>
    <span class="n">fricative_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fricative_energy</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">median</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">fricative_energy</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># Count significant frames</span>
    <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">fricative_energy</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">shape</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># Total frames for normalization</span>
    
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">fricative_frames</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">calculate_plosive_density</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2048</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">plosive_range</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">500</span><span class="p">)):</span>

    <span class="n">plosive_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">where</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">freqs</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">plosive_range</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">&amp;</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">freqs</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">plosive_range</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]))[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
    
    <span class="n">plosive_energy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">stft</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">plosive_idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">:]</span>
    <span class="n">burst_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plosive_energy</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">median</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">plosive_energy</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># Burst detection</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">burst_frames</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">calculate_vocal_smoothness</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2048</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">512</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">stft</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">stft</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n_fft</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">flux</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sqrt</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">stft</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">**</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">axis</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># Spectral Flux across frames</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Optional: Combine with zero-crossing rate or spectral centroid for more vocal smoothness features</span>
    <span class="n">zero_crossing_rate</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">feature</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">zero_crossing_rate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">smoothness_score</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">flux</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">flux</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># Inverse to get smoothness</span>
    
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">smoothness_score</span>


<span class="c1">#def analyze_audio_features(audio, sr=22050, chunk_duration=1):</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_audio_features</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">22050</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">chunk_duration</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.5</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="c1"># sr none preserves the frequency of the file per se</span>

    <span class="n">pacing_variance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">calculate_pacing_variance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fricative_density</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">calculate_fricative_density</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">plosive_density</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">calculate_plosive_density</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># pacing_variance = np.var(onset_env)</span>
    
    <span class="n">chunk_samples</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">)</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">calculate_vocal_smoothness</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">hop_length</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">spectral_flux</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">librosa</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">onset</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">onset_strength</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">audio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">sr</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">spectral_flux</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">size</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>  <span class="c1"># Handle empty flux case</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span>  
    
    <span class="n">flux</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">spectral_flux</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># Spectral flux computation</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">flux</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">size</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">flux</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>  <span class="c1"># Handle empty or zero flux</span>
        <span class="n">smoothness_score</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">smoothness_score</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">flux</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">flux</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># Inverse to get smoothness</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">smoothness_score</span>
