    <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
    
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">gray_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cvtColor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">COLOR_BGR2GRAY</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="n">luminance_values</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">edges</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Canny</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edges</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">edges</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">size</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="n">laplacian_var</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Laplacian</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">texture_variances</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">laplacian_var</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="n">dx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sobel</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ksize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">dy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sobel</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ksize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">sharpness_values</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dx</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dy</span><span class="p">)))</span>
        
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">diff</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">absdiff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">prev_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">transition_differences</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">255.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">gray_frame</span>
    
    <span class="n">luminance_variance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">luminance_values</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">motion_intensity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">transition_differences</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">transition_differences</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">visual_silence_ratio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">x</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">transition_differences</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sharpness_values</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">sharpness_values</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">texture_variance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">texture_variances</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">texture_variances</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s1">'frame_density'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'motion_intensity'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">motion_intensity</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'transition_sharpness'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'edge_dynamics'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'texture_variance'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">texture_variance</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'luminance_variance'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">luminance_variance</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'visual_silence_ratio'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">visual_silence_ratio</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_video_chunks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">audio_frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">audio_sr</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">VideoCapture</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FPS</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FPS</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">30</span>  <span class="c1"># Default to 30 FPS if unknown</span>
    <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT</span><span class="p">))</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Convert audio frame length (samples) into seconds</span>
    <span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">audio_frame_length</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">audio_sr</span>  <span class="c1"># Seconds per audio chunk</span>
    <span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">fps</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Corresponding frames per video chunk</span>

    <span class="n">video_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">total_frames</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Jump to the correct frame</span>
        
        <span class="n">frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">()</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">break</span>
            <span class="n">frames</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">chunk_features</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">analyze_video_features</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fps</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Now correctly passes frames</span>
            <span class="n">video_chunks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_features</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">release</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">destroyAllWindows</span><span class="p">()</span>
    
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">video_chunks</span>
</pre></div>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">calculate_feature_variation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_values</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">feature_values</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">v</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">item</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">isinstance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ndarray</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="n">v</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">v</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">feature_values</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># Convert arrays to scalars</span>
    <span class="n">variation</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feature_values</span><span class="p">))</span>

    <span class="n">global_similarity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pearsonr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">global_audio_features</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">global_video_features</span><span class="p">)[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>

    <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">None</span>

    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">gray_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cvtColor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">COLOR_BGR2GRAY</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="n">luminance_values</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">edges</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Canny</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edges</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">edges</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">size</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">laplacian_var</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Laplacian</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">texture_variances</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">laplacian_var</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">dx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sobel</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ksize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">dy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sobel</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ksize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">sharpness_values</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dx</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dy</span><span class="p">)))</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">diff</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">absdiff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">prev_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">transition_differences</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">255.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">gray_frame</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s1">'frame_density'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'motion_intensity'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">transition_differences</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">transition_differences</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'transition_sharpness'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sharpness_values</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">sharpness_values</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'edge_dynamics'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'texture_variance'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">texture_variances</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">texture_variances</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'luminance_variance'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">luminance_values</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'visual_silence_ratio'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">transition_differences</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.1</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_video_chunks1</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">audio_frame_length</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">audio_sr</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">VideoCapture</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">total_frames</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT</span><span class="p">))</span>

        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Warning: No frames detected in </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> or FPS is zero."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="c1"># Convert audio frame length (samples) into seconds</span>
    <span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">audio_frame_length</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">audio_sr</span>  <span class="c1"># Duration per audio chunk in seconds</span>
    <span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_duration</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">fps</span><span class="p">))</span>  <span class="c1"># At least 1 frame per chunk</span>

    <span class="n">video_chunks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">total_frames</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Jump to the correct frame</span>

        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frames_per_chunk</span><span class="p">):</span>

            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">break</span>
            <span class="n">frames</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">chunk_features</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">analyze_video_features1</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frames</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fps</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">video_chunks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">chunk_features</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">destroyAllWindows</span><span class="p">()</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">video_chunks</span>

<span class="n">hybrid_scores</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="n">hybrid_score</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="mf">0.3</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">transition_scores</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span>
            <span class="mf">0.3</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">intermediate_transition_scores</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span>

            <span class="mf">0.2</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">global_coherence_scores</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">hybrid_scores</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hybrid_score</span><span class="p">)</span>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">cosine_similarity</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vector_a</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">vector_b</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Calculate the cosine similarity between two vectors.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">dot_product</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vector_a</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">vector_b</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">norm_a</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">linalg</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">norm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vector_a</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">norm_b</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">linalg</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">norm</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vector_b</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">norm_a</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">norm_b</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span>  <span class="c1"># To handle division by zero</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">dot_product</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">norm_a</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">norm_b</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>

<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">cv2</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">analyze_video_features</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">VideoCapture</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">video_path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">luminance_values</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">transition_differences</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">sharpness_values</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="n">texture_variances</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    
    <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
    <span class="n">fps</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CAP_PROP_FPS</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">while</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">isOpened</span><span class="p">():</span>
        <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">read</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">ret</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">break</span>
        
        <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

        <span class="c1"># Convert frame to grayscale for analysis</span>
        <span class="n">gray_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cvtColor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">COLOR_BGR2GRAY</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Luminance (mean pixel intensity)</span>
        <span class="n">luminance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">luminance_values</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">luminance</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="c1"># Edge dynamics (Canny edge count)</span>
        <span class="n">edges</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Canny</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">edge_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edges</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">edges</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">size</span>
        <span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edge_count</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="c1"># Texture variance (Laplacian variance)</span>
        <span class="n">laplacian_var</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Laplacian</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">texture_variances</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">laplacian_var</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="c1"># Sharpness estimation (Sum of absolute gradient differences)</span>
        <span class="n">dx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sobel</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ksize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">dy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Sobel</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">CV_64F</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ksize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">sharpness</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dx</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dy</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">sharpness_values</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sharpness</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Motion intensity (difference between consecutive frames)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">diff</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">absdiff</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">prev_frame</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">gray_frame</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">transition_differences</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">diff</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">255.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">prev_frame</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">gray_frame</span>

    <span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">release</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">cv2</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">destroyAllWindows</span><span class="p">()</span>

    <span class="c1"># Calculate additional features</span>
    <span class="n">frame_density</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">fps</span>
    <span class="n">luminance_variance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">var</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">luminance_values</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">motion_intensity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">transition_differences</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">transition_differences</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="c1">#color_dynamics = np.var(luminance_values)</span>
    <span class="n">visual_silence_ratio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">x</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">transition_differences</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">0.1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">frame_count</span>
    <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sharpness_values</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">sharpness_values</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
    <span class="n">texture_variance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">texture_variances</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">texture_variances</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s1">'frame_density'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">frame_density</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'motion_intensity'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">motion_intensity</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'transition_sharpness'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">transition_sharpness</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'edge_dynamics'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">edge_dynamics</span><span class="p">),</span>
        <span class="s1">'texture_variance'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">texture_variance</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'luminance_variance'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">luminance_variance</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s1">'visual_silence_ratio'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">visual_silence_ratio</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
</pre></div>
